Be inspired to heal. At Cleveland University-Kansas City (CUKC), we offer the following degree programs:
Doctor of Chiropractic degree
Master of Science in Health Education and Promotion
Bachelor of Science in Human Biology
Associate of Arts degree in Biological Sciences
Associate of Applied Science in Occupational Therapy Assistant
Associate of Applied Science in Radiologic Technology degree

Be the difference in health care. Join the movement.
https://www.cleveland.edu/
